workout.name: Arm Workout
workout.description: Focus on building and toning your biceps and triceps for stronger arms.

exercises.name: Bicep Curls
exercises.description: A classic exercise to isolate and build the bicep muscles.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.description: Use a bench or chair to effectively target your triceps.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.description: A variation of the bicep curl that also works the forearms.

workout.name: Abs Workout
workout.description: A core-focused routine to build abdominal strength and definition.

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.description: A fundamental core exercise that targets the upper abdominals.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.description: An effective exercise for targeting the lower abdominal muscles.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.description: A core exercise that strengthens the obliques. Aim for 15 reps per side.

workout.name: Chest Workout
workout.description: Build a powerful and defined chest with these essential exercises.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.description: The classic lift for building upper body strength and chest mass.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.description: An isolation exercise that stretches and builds the pectoral muscles.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Ups
exercises.description: A push-up variation that puts more emphasis on the upper chest.

workout.name: Leg Workout
workout.description: A complete lower body workout to build strength and muscle in your legs.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.description: The king of all leg exercises, targeting quads, hamstrings, and glutes.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: A great exercise for improving balance and single-leg strength. Aim for 12 reps per leg.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.description: Isolate and build the calf muscles for complete leg development.

workout.name: Shoulder Workout
workout.description: Develop strong, broad shoulders with this targeted routine.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: A key compound lift for building overall shoulder mass and strength.

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Isolates the side deltoids to create a broader shoulder appearance.

exercises.name: Front Raises
exercises.description: Targets the front deltoids, important for shoulder definition.

workout.name: Back Workout
workout.description: Build a strong and wide back with these fundamental pulling exercises.

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
exercises.description: A challenging bodyweight exercise that is excellent for back width.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Rows
exercises.description: A compound exercise that builds thickness and strength in the mid-back.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: A full-body lift that is fantastic for overall back development and strength.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: A key compound lift for building overall shoulder mass and strength.
